# Test fixtures

`outer-mail.msg` and `attached-eml.msg` are Outlook messages from the test suite of
[HiraokaHyperTools/msgreader](https://github.com/HiraokaHyperTools/msgreader) (Apache License 2.0),
originally `test/Outer mail.msg` and `test/Attach sample eml sent.msg`. They contain no real booking data.
